archetypes.name: dyn-adapter-races
archetypes.rationale: The locked replace and fresh-launch paths coordinate result, registry, and sentinel mutation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the bgjob adapter decision lock and explicit replacement flow. Check concurrent callers, active or unverifiable registries, late result publication, and fresh-only clearing for launch duplication or stale-state reuse. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
